title: Hone Health vs TMates vs Male Excel: Online TRT Compared
description:
Hone Health, TMates and Male Excel compared on how treatment starts and what ongoing care looks like.

What we compared:
• Hone Health: begins with lab testing to confirm whether testosterone is clinically low; ongoing monitoring with follow-up bloodwork and dose adjustments
• TMates: TRT-first program; lab testing and a licensed-clinician review; membership model with support built in
• Male Excel: comprehensive at-home lab testing; TRT medication if prescribed (injections or cream); unlimited provider follow-ups

Provider details as listed in our reviews (updated Sep 14, 2026). Confirm current plans on each provider's site.

Full guide: https://www.treatmentshub.com/trt
The comparison page this video is based on was reviewed for medical accuracy by Francheska Capistrano, RMT, MPH (medical content reviewer) on Oct 30, 2026.

Important:
• The presenter in this video is AI-generated.
• TreatmentsHub is a comparison site, not a medical provider. This is general information, not medical advice.
• Prescription treatment needs an evaluation by a licensed clinician, who decides whether it's right for you.
• TRT is long-term and can affect fertility; it needs ongoing monitoring by a clinician.
• We may earn a commission from partner links. It never affects our rankings.
How we rank: https://www.treatmentshub.com/weight-loss/how-we-rank
